metadata.description: Personal marketplace for forge-sdlc and workbench. Add this repository, then install forge-sdlc at project scope in a host and workbench (the cmux hooks) at user scope.

plugins.name: forge-sdlc
plugins.description: The AI-native SDLC loop as a team of agents over Matt Pocock's skills, with the workbench mod: /focus-pane, /boards, a needs-you band above the prompt, /diff-pane, /side-chat, /morning, /crew. Depends on mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official.

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: The command hooks that feed the cmux sidebars and the cmux-crew skill. Standalone, silent outside cmux; the views are the workbench mod of forge-sdlc and emag-sdlc.
